title: diagram.v1
description: The elements of one diagram, as the framework's adapter reads them from the diagram tool's source (Archify JSON first) plus the diagram's invariants file (invariants.v1). Gates never read a diagram tool's format directly: they read this element list. A requirement's derived_from points at <diagram>#<id>.

diagram.description: Diagram ID: the source file name up to its first dot (cache-miss-request.sequence.json -> cache-miss-request).

type.description: The diagram type, as the diagram tool declares it.

source.description: Repository-relative path of the diagram source.

id.description: Unique within the diagram. Taken from the diagram source (Archify component, participant, connection or message ID) or from the invariants file (INV-<n>).

label.description: Every element is labelled: an unlabelled edge or message is a check_diagram_contract_gate finding, so the adapter never emits one.

source.description: Where the element is declared, when not in the diagram source (invariants come from <diagram>.invariants.yaml).

line.description: Line of the declaration, for findings, when the adapter can tell.
